labeling.selection: four evenly spaced plus four smallest policy gaps per game
labeling.eligibility: teacher completedDepth strictly exceeds the collecting move completedDepth

training.heldout: seed modulo 5 equals zero; fixed generation-one diagnostic holdout; heldout states excluded from training

promotion: screen only; positive finalist requires independent >=400-game paired confirmation, legality and latency gates

confirmationSelection.eligibility: at least 53% overall points against each anchor in color-balanced paired matches, with all native/parity checks passing
confirmationSelection.selection: highest minimum point rate across the two anchors; then highest mean rate; then later generation
confirmationSelection.confirmation: 400 fresh paired games against each anchor at the same d5/b256/256k envelope; do not pool with screening games
confirmationSelection.promotion: require lower paired-bootstrap 95% bound above 50% against each anchor and at least 53% overall points; report color splits as diagnostics, plus clean replay, representative-game review, and a separate deployed-latency check
confirmationSelection.colorRationale: Preregistered before any arena started. Balanced pairing controls first-player advantage. Above-50% in each color is not required: it can reject a stronger challenger when Light has an intrinsic advantage. Retain both color splits in every report.

correction: Absolute-depth-five pilot superseded before any arena: movement roots were almost entirely filtered out. All three learning generations restart at g0 under the relative-depth rule; g1 raw games/labels are reused unchanged.
